Run a beta_community sweep and back-solve R0 via the final-size method

Source: R/time_varying_transmission_calibration.R
run_beta_sweep.Rd

Run a beta_community sweep and back-solve R0 via the final-size method

Usage

run_beta_sweep(
  transmission_fraction,
  model_params,
  beta_community_range = c(0.01, 0.25),
  n_beta = 25L,
  population = NULL,
  n_reps = NULL,
  sim_time = NULL,
  n_cores = NULL,
  seed = 42L,
  out_file = NULL
)

Arguments

transmission_fraction

Named numeric vector with names household, workplace, leisure, community, summing to 1. Used to derive the setting-specific beta ratios relative to beta_community. beta_school is always set equal to beta_workplace.

model_params

A parameters list from get_parameters() (e.g. get_parameters(archetype = "flu") or a fully custom get_parameters(overrides = list(duration_exposed = ..., ...))). Supplies natural history (duration_exposed, duration_infectious, hospitalization/death probabilities, etc.) and the defaults for population, n_reps, and sim_time below. Initial condition proportions are derived from model_params$number_initial_S/E/I/R relative to model_params$human_population, then rescaled to whichever population is actually used.

beta_community_range

Numeric vector c(min, max) for the beta sweep. Default c(0.01, 0.25).

n_beta

Number of beta values to sweep, linearly spaced across beta_community_range. Default 25.

population

Population size for all runs. If NULL, falls back to model_params$human_population.

n_reps

Number of stochastic replicates per beta value. If NULL, falls back to 20.

sim_time

Simulation length in days. If NULL, falls back to model_params$simulation_time.

n_cores

Number of cores for parallel execution. If NULL, falls back to min(detectCores() - 1, 10).

seed

Random seed. Default 42.

out_file

Optional file path to save the result via saveRDS(). If NULL (default), the result is only returned, not saved.

Value

A list with:

  • sweep_table: data.frame with columns beta_community, AR_mean, AR_sd, R0_fs_mean, R0_fs_sd (fs = final-size). One row per swept beta value; R0_fs_mean and R0_fs_sd are NA for subcritical beta values (those that do not produce a self-sustaining epidemic).

  • args: a named list recording every resolved argument used, for full reproducibility of the sweep.

  • call_time: POSIXct timestamp of when the sweep was run.

See also

Other calibration: generate_beta_sweep_plot(), generate_time_varying_beta_vectors(), get_R0_from_attack_rate(), get_beta_from_R0_finalsize(), get_sweep_result_from_source(), run_one_sweep_replicate()
